get.summary: Page original owned desktop task notification events
get.description: Read-only original owner-scoped immutable event identity; no task/terminal/channel effect or execution grant. Revalidate original task/version/generation/role epoch/settings and causal source in the same read snapshot. Revoked entries expose original metadata only, with null candidate/settings. Completion requires original business finalization and assistant message, not a UI status or ordinary successful run. No private final message/page/interaction body is exposed. Responses are private, no-store. Ascending immutable sequence, at most50 owned rows plus one lookahead. Cursor is an owned event ID, remains valid when that source is revoked, and cannot cross owners. Advance with next_event_id even when all returned entries are revoked. A missing cursor starts the retained owned ledger; this is not a promise to send historical events or authorize legacy occurrences without captured proof.

get.summary: Read an exact-opened native Office PDF preview.
get.description: Convert an owned typed native Office member from at most100MiB sealed source using the original configured LibreOffice readiness and shared document/print single-job admission. Preserve original macro-disabled, external-link-disabled, save/reopen and page-count checks. Bind derived PDF retention to owner, original activity/native member evidence and complete native opened-source digest. Retained PDF storage shares original512MiB/128-entry accounting. Output is100 bytes..20MiB PDF with full SHA, source SHA/size, original member/path/open digests and page count. When any preview pin is supplied require all three pins and open_sha256, verify the complete original source from live or privately retained opened bytes and read that retained PDF without reconversion. Recheck member/activity/history authority after conversion/read. Source capture and outgoing PDF streams retain native4-slot/512MiB accounting through response cleanup, with180-second timeout/cancellation. The original owned database activity binding remains required. Native reference receipt integration is tracked separately. When configured, the Gateway issues a domain-separated HMAC receipt over the original owner/activity/member/history/opened-source and complete content tuple. Follow-up requests can supply that receipt for fresh source verification. Exact open_sha256 requests first look up the originally verified owned opening in private retained storage. Revalidate original actor/conversation/run/activity/history authority and exact result/member/open identity, copy64KiB windows into the existing request-private unlinked spool, and verify complete size/SHA before headers. This retained path does not require current SDK/file availability. Missing entries may only recapture the same requested opening; corrupt entries fail closed. New verified openings are retained best-effort with Office PDFs under one512MiB/128-entry quota, including metadata, without eviction. Ordinary read capacity remains4 jobs/512MiB through response cleanup. A false retention result keeps current viewing available and does not promise later source reopening. Native staging space and crash-abandoned native reservations count toward that same retention quota. For print requests, the original checked PDF conversion/retention completes before best-effort original-file retention.

PersistentTaskTrigger.description: Calendar schedules use an IANA timezone validated by the service and HH:mm local time. Cron schedules use five fields. Sunday is weekday 0. A DST gap runs at the next valid local time; a fold runs only at its first occurrence. Missed daily, weekly, and Cron occurrences default to coalesce. skip drops a backlog when a later slot is already due; catch_up advances one original slot at a time. Capacity-deferred work keeps its original due time. Delay schedules freeze their due time at acceptance.

PreviewWorkbenchMemoryImport.description: Accept original Jot documents, pinned v4 current-project snapshots or an exact immutable source file version from the original owner/workspace/target project.
